verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Figma Make publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, which suggests there is no documented programmatic surface for Make at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
